0022600184.text: The San Antonio Spurs (5-2, on a five-game winning streak and 3rd in the Southwest, 1.5 games back) host the Dallas Mavericks (4-3, coming off a loss and 4th in the Southwest, 2.5 games back), with the Spurs 6th in the West and Dallas 9th. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain), while Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee, strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel, inflammation), and Kyrie Irving (knee) and Max Christie (hip) are day-to-day game-time decisions. The Spurs lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 122-106 win in Dallas on October 24, and they won the 2025-26 series 4-0.
